fields.label: Student
fields.description: Empty on a partner-initiated invite until the student redeems it; required once the link is Active (enforced in the controller)

fields.label: Partner
fields.description: Set once the invite is accepted and the partner's own login exists

fields.label: Relationship
fields.options:
Parent
Guardian
Sibling
Teacher
Mentor
Sponsor

fields.label: Contact
fields.description: Phone number or email the invite was sent to

fields.label: Pairing Code
fields.description: Single-use 6-digit pairing code minted at invite time (P3.2 — replaced web-link tokens); cleared once accepted

fields.label: Code Expires At
fields.description: Pairing codes are valid for 48 hours; expired codes are treated as invalid

fields.label: Initiated By
fields.description: Which side sent the invite (P3.1 partner-first signup). Direction never changes the partner's reporting-only scope.

fields.label: Payer
fields.description: Who is billed for the student's subscription (P3.1 partner-as-payer, delegated billing — the subscription stays the student's)

fields.label: Weekly Email Digest
fields.description: Partner opt-in: email the weekly progress report every Sunday evening. Off by default; the partner toggles it from their app. Gates only an email of the same report the dashboard already shows — no new data.
